## Objective
- Build a complete, playable third-person dungeon exploration game with pixelated atmospheric graphics, fluid movement, procedural dungeons, and a character-creation start screen.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save screenshots for checks as small JPEGs no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires PNG.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game using HTML, CSS, and Canvas, with no external game engine.
- Character paths: Warden, Ranger, and Arcanist; procedural maze, relic collection, enemies, and an exit gate.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added character-creation screen, responsive interface, pixel-art dungeon renderer, combat, movement, dodge, enemy AI, minimap, sound effects, pause, and win/lose states.
- Verified menu and gameplay in Playwright and saved screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/gloam-menu.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/gloam-play.jpg`.
- Updated dungeon generation to place the starting point near the map center.

### Active
- Validate the centered-start generation update and check for gameplay issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload and playtest the latest `game.js` generation change; confirm start location, HUD, movement, combat, relics, and gate completion.
2. Check browser console for any issues beyond the earlier `favicon.ico` 404.
3. Summarize the finished game and note key assumptions when responding to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens, character creation, HUD, controls, pause and end overlays.
- `style.css`: Pixel-art game presentation and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Procedural map generation, rendering, movement, combat, enemies, relics, UI, and input.

## Important Context
- Local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright browser opened `http://localhost:3002`; latest screenshot was taken before the final start-position edit.
- Changes are uncommitted.
